en: Do you truly believe you're making progress? You can never defeat the Scourge! These small victories are nothing more than a ploy to make you overconfident!

Even if I did, fool, do you think I'd just let you take it from me?  The only way you'd ever get it - if I did possess it - is to pry it from my cold, dead fingers.$B$BThat, my little friend, will not be happening any time soon.
Did you see?  That last firework almost caught that drawf's shirt on fire!  Hah!
Time for my patrol.  I'll be back shortly.
This frozen land shall suffice for a start.  Come to me, mortals - and I shall give you a quick and painful death.

During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of this armor worn by heroes.

Blessings of An'she, child.

We have a tradition of scattering incense to the winds, and I was wondering if you'd be interested in honoring our tradition.

You will need to craft the incense by purchasing herbs from Nida, cedar from Nata, sinew thread from Mahu in the mid rise, and ceremonial flint and tinder from Naal on the upper rise. Once you have these items, combine them and spread them off the south facing cliff of Hunter's Rise.

You will find a mat and incense at the ceremonial site.
The spirit of Echeyakee flows through you, $n.
